senses.gloss:
Nona
father of Ānandavardhana (a. of Dhvanyāloka); ref. to a. the end of his Devīśataka, verse 101; patronised by Avantivarman of Kashmir (Rājataraṅgiṇī V. 34).

Nonarāja
father of Jonarāja (a. of C. Ṭīkā on Kirātārjunīya of Bhāravi, BORI. D. XIII. i. 93; Rājataraṅgiṇī, BORI. D. XIII. ii. 623).
